source_pr_title: fix(gha-runner): don't chmod the root-owned PVC root
author: amazon-q-developer
body:
:stop_sign: **Logic Error**: Permission healing is skipped if `/nix-pvc/store` doesn't exist, even if `/nix-pvc/var` exists from a previous failed seed. This causes tar extraction to fail when `/nix-pvc/var` has read-only permissions but no `/nix-pvc/store` directory exists. Check for both directories independently to ensure all stale permissions are healed before extraction.
```suggestion
  if [ -d /nix-pvc/store ]; then
    chmod -R u+rwX /nix-pvc/store
  fi
  if [ -d /nix-pvc/var ]; then
    chmod -R u+rwX /nix-pvc/var
  fi
```
